$ llm.py --help    # help
[exit 0]
--- stdout
usage: llm.py [-h] {run,exec,lint,health} ...

positional arguments:
  {run,exec,lint,health}
    exec                long-running streaming session: build the flags from the declaration, then
                        exec claude (stdin/stdout are stream-json)
    health              whether each provider in hub.json llm works (key, connection, model there)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
--- stderr

$ llm.py run --help    # help
[exit 0]
--- stdout
usage: llm.py run [-h] [--cwd CWD] [--model MODEL] [--prompt-file PROMPT_FILE] [--dry-run]
                  point [extra ...]

positional arguments:
  point
  extra                 extra claude arguments (after --)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cwd CWD
  --model MODEL
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
  --dry-run             only print the command that would run; no model call
--- stderr

$ llm.py exec --help    # help
[exit 0]
--- stdout
usage: llm.py exec [-h] [--cwd CWD] [--model MODEL] [--prompt-file PROMPT_FILE] point [extra ...]

positional arguments:
  point
  extra

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --cwd CWD
  --model MODEL
  --prompt-file PROMPT_FILE
--- stderr

$ llm.py run nosuch    # unknown point
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
llm.py: nosuch is not a declared judgment point (contracts/llm-points.yaml)

$ llm.py exec reflect-week    # exec without stream
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
llm.py: reflect-week does not declare stream: true, so it cannot exec

$ llm.py exec lease-session    # runtime without stream
[exit 2]
--- stdout
--- stderr
llm.py: lease-session: this runtime does not support long-running streaming sessions

$ llm.py run reflect-week    # no completion
[exit 1]
--- stdout
{"type": "result", "is_error": true, "structured_output": null, "llm_point": "reflect-week", "llm_error": "runtime none has no completion interface, and hub.json has no llm section (set up an LLM provider)"}
--- stderr

$ llm.py run agent-job    # no agent

--- stderr
